checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned historical releases, runtime contracts, strict weight loads and fixed-panel comparator check.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weight crosses dataset boundaries. LoRa exact R69 weight is unavailable under this source contract; native R17 is the current matched DURA family comparator in the screen. A like-for-like two-stage LoRa DURA adaptation is still needed before final acceptance.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Per dataset, on the fixed RX and 192 matched pairs, the candidate must net at least 8 extra correct in low urban versus every control, and each 95% paired bootstrap lower bound must exceed zero. Clean correct must meet or exceed maximum control. Two views and all four paths frozen before independent scorer. Proceed to separately preregistered official evaluation only for a passing dataset.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: Read actual N607 slots. [5,2,6,3,0,7], at least 12288 MiB and fewer than eight contexts. One worker per card, at most two; serialize if one.
execution.stop_rule: Failed real no-query smoke, illegal/missing parent, nonfinite/freeze mismatch or insufficient fixed blind receiver coverage halts dependent stages. Failed screen records result and no full expansion.

notes: Hypothesis: combine the real-gain and DURA native IQ recoveries by solving a DURA MAP residual problem in the complement of the anchor edit, using half the companion-minus-anchor as the prior. The two CG updates and 25% raw edit norm cap are fixed. Estimated A and v come from the original DURA module on current received IQ, no test-based fitting.

Shared solver on both. LoRa anchor is the documented real-gain waveform, companion native R17, front end E104. WiSig anchor is frozen R69, companion dataset-trained phase-aware signed-real spectral gain. WiSig adapter uses 20-point STF correlation over the fixed 80–199 interval and width 32 versus LoRa width 1024; both share packet U-Net and spectral innovation code. The new WiSig weights are from scratch.

LoRa source V b200_1 and WiSig source V receiver 1 selected by fixed lowest registered index and 192 draws, without scoring. LoRa excludes the earlier 300-panel IDs. WiSig established source panel previously exposed. Original complete targets are sequestered from this release; already exposed historical benchmark results remain documented.

Formal references still pending: same-condition LoRa DURA v1 mechanism counterpart and WiSig real gain exact Full testing. New architecture will not start complete tests until the screen rule is met and formal matrix locked.
